scope: Original base game standard core + applicable linked Living FAQ; optional modules excluded

questions.question: The Trees and Stones Speak of War is used with five Dahan and its threshold Pushes two to different adjacent lands. How much Defend stays and reaches each destination? Does a later unrelated Dahan move carry it further?
When Ocean Drowns a Town and a City, when is Fear earned and where do pieces go? In two-Spirit play how much Energy value is a drowned City worth, can change be made, and do Dahan yield Energy?

A Ravage adds Blight that reduces Vital Strength of the Earth’s Sacred Site to one Presence. Does losing the site retroactively remove its Defend from the Damage simultaneously dealt to Dahan in that Ravage?
What is the order of the Invader Phase, and if a Blighted Island start-of-phase effect destroys a Spirit’s last Presence, may an earned Fear Card resolve first to avert defeat?
